scenarios.name: closing a page stamps its cutoff from the hub's clock and keeps it, reopening clears it, a page cannot be closed without one, and a cutoff still to come is not kept

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_updates__pages (id, title, about, status, closed_at, messages_visibility, created_by, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, '', ?, ?, 'everyone', ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
UPDATE app_updates__pages SET status = 'closed' WHERE id = 'p1'

UPDATE app_updates__pages SET title = ?, about = ?, status = ?, messages_visibility = ?, closed_at = CASE WHEN ? = 'open' THEN NULL ELSE MIN(COALESCE(closed_at, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) END WHERE id = ?
SELECT id, title, about, status, messages_visibility FROM app_updates__pages WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at > '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND closed_at LIKE '____-__-__T__:__:__.___Z'
UPDATE app_updates__pages SET closed_at = '2026-02-02T00:00:00.000Z' WHERE id = 'p1'

UPDATE app_updates__pages SET title = ?, about = ?, status = ?, messages_visibility = ?, closed_at = CASE WHEN ? = 'open' THEN NULL ELSE MIN(COALESCE(closed_at, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) END WHERE id = ?
SELECT id, status, closed_at, messages_visibility FROM app_updates__pages

UPDATE app_updates__pages SET status = 'closed', closed_at = MIN(COALESCE(closed_at, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) WHERE id = ? AND status = 'archived'
